about: Ledge kills (the owner, 15 Nov: knocked off the edge = dead, loot at the ledge; elites and bosses stop at the brink). Read by logic/Maps/LedgeEdges.cs (edges, kinds) and src/Actors/CrowdView.cs + src/Fx/BattleFx.cs (fall, brink). EDGES: which of a dungeon's edges are a drop, by the kind of edge, as the play camera sees it (src/World/DungeonWalls.cs Ctx.HLoc builds them so): hole = a hole or pit in a room's floor (holeGap: a cell is a hole's when HoleField - WallField is under it; the den's WallOnly parts them at 1.775, the ravine's at 0); near = a wall whose outside faces the lens (+z); side = one facing sideways; backOpen = a back wall with walkable ground within openProbe metres behind it (the ravine drops these too); back = the back wall with rock behind it. A dungeon named here drops at the kinds in its list and stops a foe at the rest (an empty list: none, as the den is now); a dungeon not named drops nowhere (a new dungeon's walls stop foes until its look says). KINDS: the view's own thresholds, at their midpoints (near Sm(0.3,0.65) of the outward normal's z; side Sm(0.45,0.8) of |x|; open Sm(10,16) of how far the wall runs on behind). FALL (CrowdView, a foe with Enemy.Fell): thrown on from where it crossed along the push at its slide's speed (runMin..runMax m/s, a heavy body heavyRun slower), it rides the drawn ground (the floor, a den's pit in it, a ravine's shoulder and cliff: DungeonWalls.EdgeFall) under gravity g, leaving it where the ground falls away faster and running down a slope it lands on (rub: its drag); it tips over along the push (flipDeg for a light body, dragDeg for a heavy one: mass lightMass and under is light, heavyMass and over heavy, between eased; a heavy body's tip starts heavyLag later), shrinks to shrinkTo and darkens to darkTo with time and with depth (full by darkDeep metres down), gone by the end of DieTime (dissolve over the last fadeT). BRINK (an elite or a boss stopped at the brink): leans back from the drop leanDeg as it skids, eased in over leanIn; as it stops it teeters toward the drop (teeter times the lean, over 0.35 s) and comes upright over leanOut; dust at the lip on both.

hollow.parked: the owner, 15 Nov evening: no ledges in the den for now ('we can come back to those'); its walls and pits stop a foe. Its pits were the one drop the view allows: ["hole"] turns them on
